why_separate: Pharming reported in euros until 2020 and changed its presentation currency to US dollars from 1 January 2021, with US dollar comparatives for 2020 onward; gold holds one currency per issuer within a series, so the euro quarters 2017Q1-2019Q4 are kept beside the US dollar series that starts in 2020Q1 rather than joined to it. value_normalized_usd_millions converts each row.
notes: 2017Q1 is the first full quarter in which Pharming took all US RUCONEST product sales after acquiring the commercialization rights from Valeant; earlier quarters are its supply-price revenue from licensees, a different scope. Pharming's total revenues are RUCONEST product sales plus amortised license fee income; the business is exclusively recombinant C1 esterase inhibitor. Quarters not printed as a quarter figure are year-to-date differences with every input quoted.
